BUSINESS ANALYST (PROCESS & SYSTEMS) JOB SUMMARY An established insurance brokerage is seeking a Business Analyst (Process & Systems) to act as the link between business operations and technology. The role analyses how work is done today, defines what the business needs, and ensures that system changes, automation and process improvements deliver measurable results. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Process Analysis & Improvement - Map current ("as-is") processes, identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks and control gaps, and design improved ("to-be") processes. - Identify opportunities for automation and AI, and work with the AI & Automation team to define and prioritise solutions. - Define and track KPIs to measure the impact of process and system changes. Requirements & Solution Delivery - Gather, analyse and document business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. - Translate business needs into clear specifications for internal teams, IT, vendors and system providers. - Support system implementations, upgrades and integrations, including data migration and go-live. - Plan, coordinate and participate in user acceptance testing (UAT), and validate that solutions meet requirements. Stakeholder Engagement & Change - Facilitate workshops with stakeholders across departments to align on problems, priorities and solutions. - Prepare business cases, cost-benefit analyses and reports for senior management. - Develop process documentation, SOPs and training materials, and support user adoption after go-live. EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS Minimum Requirements: - Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field. Desirable: - Business analysis certification (e.g. IIBA ECBA/CCBA/CBAP) or process improvement certification (e.g. Lean Six Sigma). MINIMUM EXPERIENCE - 3–5 years' experience in business analysis, process improvement or systems implementation. - Experience in insurance, banking or financial services is an asset. - Experience with policy administration, benefits administration or claims systems is an asset. REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES - Process mapping using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, Miro or BPMN notation. - Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills. - Good working knowledge of Excel; SQL or Power BI is an asset. - Experience with system implementation projects. - Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot to support analysis and documentation is an asset, together with sound judgment on protecting confidential data. - Excellent facilitation, communication and stakeholder management skills. - Analytical, structured thinker with strong attention to detail.
